definitions.meaning: chào, chào hỏi ai đó

examples: She greeted her guests warmly at the door.
It's polite to greet your neighbours when you see them.

definitions.meaning: giới thiệu (ai đó với ai đó)

examples: Let me introduce you to my colleague, Sarah.
He introduced himself with a handshake and a smile.

definitions.meaning: lời tạm biệt, sự chia tay

examples: We said our farewells at the airport before she boarded the plane.
The farewell party was emotional but memorable.

definitions.meaning: người quen (không thân thiết)

examples: He's not a close friend — just an acquaintance from work.
We ran into a mutual acquaintance at the coffee shop.

definitions.meaning: chuyện phiếm, nói chuyện xã giao

examples: I'm not great at small talk, so parties can feel awkward for me.
They made small talk about the weather while waiting for the meeting to start.

definitions.meaning: dễ chịu, vui vẻ, thân thiện

examples: It was a pleasant surprise to run into you here!
She has a pleasant manner that makes everyone feel at ease.

definitions.meaning: lịch sự, nhã nhặn

examples: Always be polite when you meet someone for the first time.
It's polite to ask how someone is before getting to business.

definitions.meaning: thông thường, không trang trọng, thân mật

examples: We had a casual chat over coffee after the meeting.
The tone of the conversation was friendly and casual.

definitions.meaning: gật đầu (chào hoặc đồng ý)

examples: He nodded at me from across the room as a quick greeting.
She nodded politely to show she was listening.

definitions.meaning: vẫy tay (chào hoặc tạm biệt)

examples: She waved goodbye as the train pulled away from the station.
I waved to him from across the street, but he didn't see me.

definitions.meaning: cái bắt tay

examples: They sealed the deal with a firm handshake.
A warm handshake can make a great first impression.

definitions.meaning: lời khen ngợi, lời tâng bốc

examples: She paid him a compliment on his presentation skills.
Accepting a compliment gracefully is a social skill worth learning.

definitions.meaning: trò chuyện, nói chuyện thân mật

examples: We chatted for an hour over coffee and lost track of time.
Feel free to chat with the other guests while we wait.

definitions.meaning: hàn huyên, hỏi thăm tin tức của nhau sau thời gian xa cách

examples: We should meet for coffee soon and catch up.
It was great catching up with old friends at the reunion.

definitions.meaning: rất vui được gặp bạn

examples: "Nice to meet you," she said, extending her hand.
He smiled and replied, "Nice to meet you too, I've heard a lot about you."

definitions.meaning: bạn có khỏe không? (câu hỏi thăm thông thường)

examples: "How are you?" he asked as they passed each other in the hall.
She always says "How are you?" and actually waits for the answer.

definitions.meaning: giữ gìn sức khỏe nhé, bảo trọng (câu chào tạm biệt)

examples: "Take care!" she called out as he left the office.
It's always nice to end a conversation with "take care."

definitions.meaning: hẹn gặp lại, tạm biệt nhé

examples: "See you later!" he shouted as he rushed to catch his bus.
She ended the call with a cheerful "See you later!"

definitions.meaning: chào đón, đón tiếp
xin chào mừng!

examples: The host welcomed all the guests as they arrived.
"Welcome to our city — I hope you enjoy your stay!"

definitions.meaning: xin lỗi, xin phép (dùng để thu hút sự chú ý hoặc xin đi qua)

examples: "Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest station is?"
She said "Excuse me" before squeezing past the crowd.

definitions.meaning: xin, làm ơn (dùng để yêu cầu lịch sự hơn)

examples: Could you please hold the door open for me?
"Please take a seat — the doctor will be with you shortly."

definitions.meaning: cảm ơn bạn

examples: "Thank you so much for your help — I really appreciate it."
She sent a handwritten card to say thank you after the dinner party.

definitions.meaning: không có gì, không sao (đáp lại lời cảm ơn)

examples: "Thank you for dinner!" "You're welcome — it was my pleasure."
He smiled and said "You're welcome" when she thanked him for his advice.

definitions.meaning: lâu quá không gặp nhau nhỉ

examples: "Long time no see! How have you been?" she said with a big smile.
He bumped into an old school friend and exclaimed, "Long time no see!"
synonyms: I haven't seen you in ages

definitions.meaning: dạo này thế nào, mọi thứ ổn không? (thân mật hơn how are you)

examples: "Hey, how's it going?" he asked as they walked into the office together.
"How's it going with the new job?" she asked over lunch.
